meta.title: MCP Servers Panel
meta.description: See every MCP server's connection state, tool count and configuration in the sidebar, and switch or reconnect it right there.

panel.title: MCP Servers
panel.emptyHint: Add one under Settings → Plugins → MCP server configuration, or write an mcp-client row into the profile patch.
panel.notToggleable: This server is provided by a plugin package and cannot be switched here
panel.idleHint: The MCP client is loaded but registered no tools — usually a failed connection. Use Test connection to see why.
panel.failedHint: This row failed to load. Expand it for the error; Reconnect remounts it.
panel.disabledHint: Disabled: no connection is attempted and no tools are registered.
panel.toggleSettleTimeout: Still connecting; the list refreshes automatically
